nodes.label: Heavy Mining Crawler Bulldozer
nodes.rationale: Twice as large as the medium crawler, Cat D10T/D8T class, so it can push 16+ blocks.

nodes.label: Strict Volume Conservation
nodes.rationale: Pushed volume must equal removed volume. Zero duplication, zero loss.

nodes.label: Server Authority
nodes.rationale: The server owns position, tracks, blade elevation, terrain edits, and material conservation. The client only animates and shows the HUD.

nodes.label: Triangular High-Drive Tracks
nodes.rationale: Elevated sprocket keeps the final drive out of shock loads and mud.

nodes.label: No Pyramid Columns
nodes.rationale: Forward berm height is capped at the moldboard top so lifted spoil spreads as an even layer instead of 1x1 spires.

nodes.label: Blade Kinematic Contract
nodes.rationale: BladeTransform is the shared 3D pose that entity state, HUD, terrain cutting, and volume tests all read.
